lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six semi-parallel horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank. Distribution density increases anteriorly toward the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating a discernible grid-like lattice across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from light (dorsal side) to dark (ventral side).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs localized within the anterior and medial regions of the first dorsal fin silhouette.
